result.summary: Found 1 issue: the Orders tab in the bottom navigation bar is missing its icon, while the other three tabs (Home, Search, Profile) each show one. The rest of the page (header, search, filter chips, promo banner, carousels, restaurant cards) renders as expected.

issues.description: The 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation bar has no icon. Home, Search and Profile each show an icon above their label, but Orders shows only the text label with an empty space above it, which makes the bar look inconsistent and broken.
issues.suggestion: Restore the Orders tab icon (e.g., a receipt or bag glyph). Check that the icon asset loads correctly and is rendered with the same size and tint as the other inactive tab icons.
